command:
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Write-Host "===== BOOKMARK UIA INVOKE ACCEPTANCE ====="
git fetch origin main work/bookmarks-winui --no-tags --prune
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "git fetch failed" }
if ((git rev-parse origin/main).Trim() -ne "5228cbbfc24f56d61a84975545f1d8572e7deece") { throw "main moved" }
$status=@(git status --short)
if($status.Count -ne 0){$status|%{Write-Host $_};throw "unexpected local changes"}
git checkout work/bookmarks-winui
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "checkout failed" }
git merge --ff-only origin/work/bookmarks-winui
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "branch ff failed" }
$accept=@'
from pathlib import Path
import ctypes as c, os, shutil, subprocess, time
from ctypes import wintypes as W
from pywinauto import Desktop

ROOT=Path.cwd()
EXE=ROOT/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
assert EXE.exists(),EXE
base=ROOT/"logs"/"bookmark-invoke-owned"
shutil.rmtree(base,ignore_errors=True)
source=base/"북마크원본"; other=base/"다른폴더"; imported=base/"가져온폴더"
appdata=base/"appdata"; localdata=base/"localdata"; temp=base/"tmp"
for q in (source,other,imported,appdata,localdata,temp):q.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
profile=localdata/"flyExplorer";profile.mkdir()
(profile/"ui-preferences-v1.txt").write_bytes(b"schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=details\r\n")
legacy=base/"legacy-bookmark.conf"
legacy.write_text("[bookmark]\r\nbookmark.item1.name=가져온 북마크\r\nbookmark.item1.path="+str(imported)+"\r\n",encoding="utf-16")
env={**os.environ,"APPDATA":str(appdata),"LOCALAPPDATA":str(localdata),"TEMP":str(temp),"TMP":str(temp)}

u=c.windll.user32
CALL=c.WINFUNCTYPE(W.BOOL,W.HWND,W.LPARAM)
u.EnumWindows.argtypes=[CALL,W.LPARAM];u.GetWindowThreadProcessId.argtypes=[W.HWND,c.POINTER(W.DWORD)]
u.PostMessageW.argtypes=[W.HWND,W.UINT,W.WPARAM,W.LPARAM]

def eventually(fn,label,timeout=12):
 limit=time.monotonic()+timeout
 while time.monotonic()<limit:
  try:
   if fn():return
  except Exception:pass
  time.sleep(.12)
 raise AssertionError(label)

def wins(pid):
 out=[]
 @CALL
 def cb(h,_):
  owner=W.DWORD();u.GetWindowThreadProcessId(h,c.byref(owner))
  if owner.value==pid and u.IsWindowVisible(h):out.append(int(h))
  return 1
 u.EnumWindows(cb,0);return out

def launch(start):
 p=subprocess.Popen([str(EXE),str(start)],cwd=EXE.parent,env=env,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
 eventually(lambda:wins(p.pid) or p.poll() is not None,"window")
 assert p.poll() is None
 hwnd=wins(p.pid)[0]; win=Desktop(backend="uia").window(handle=hwnd); el=lambda n:win.child_window(auto_id=n)
 eventually(lambda:str(start).lower() in el("AddressBox").get_value().lower(),"navigation",18)
 return p,hwnd,win,el

def invoke(control):
 try:
  control.invoke()
 except Exception:
  control.click()

def bookmark_button(win,name):
 expected={name,"북마크 "+name}
 for b in win.descendants(control_type="Button"):
  if b.window_text() in expected:return b
 return None

def close(p,hwnd):
 u.PostMessageW(hwnd,0x0010,0,0);p.wait(timeout=12);assert p.returncode==0

store=profile/"bookmarks-v1.txt"
p=hwnd=None;p2=hwnd2=None
try:
 p,hwnd,win,el=launch(source)
 invoke(el("AddBookmarkButton"))
 eventually(store.exists,"add did not create private store")
 eventually(lambda:"북마크원본" in store.read_text(encoding="utf-8"),"add not persisted")
 eventually(lambda:bookmark_button(win,"북마크원본") is not None,"add button not published")
 print("BOOKMARK_INVOKE_ADD_PASS",True,flush=True)

 invoke(el("BookmarkManagerButton"))
 eventually(lambda:el("BookmarkManagerBox").exists() and el("BookmarkNameEdit").exists(),"manager children unavailable")
 el("BookmarkNameEdit").set_edit_text("자주 쓰는 폴더")
 invoke(el("BookmarkRenameButton"))
 eventually(lambda:"자주 쓰는 폴더" in store.read_text(encoding="utf-8"),"rename not persisted")
 eventually(lambda:bookmark_button(win,"자주 쓰는 폴더") is not None,"rename button not published")
 print("BOOKMARK_INVOKE_RENAME_PASS",True,flush=True)

 addr=el("AddressBox");addr.set_edit_text(str(other));addr.type_keys("{ENTER}",set_foreground=True)
 eventually(lambda:str(other).lower() in addr.get_value().lower(),"navigate away",15)
 invoke(bookmark_button(win,"자주 쓰는 폴더"))
 eventually(lambda:str(source).lower() in addr.get_value().lower(),"bookmark navigation",15)
 print("BOOKMARK_INVOKE_NAVIGATION_PASS",True,flush=True)

 el("BookmarkImportPathBox").set_edit_text(str(legacy))
 invoke(el("BookmarkImportButton"))
 eventually(lambda:"가져온 북마크" in store.read_text(encoding="utf-8"),"legacy import not persisted")
 eventually(lambda:bookmark_button(win,"가져온 북마크") is not None,"import button not published")
 print("BOOKMARK_INVOKE_IMPORT_PASS",True,flush=True)

 el("BookmarkManagerBox").select(0)
 invoke(el("BookmarkDeleteButton"))
 eventually(lambda:"자주 쓰는 폴더" not in store.read_text(encoding="utf-8"),"delete not persisted")
 assert "가져온 북마크" in store.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
 print("BOOKMARK_INVOKE_DELETE_PASS",True,flush=True)
 close(p,hwnd);p=hwnd=None

 p2,hwnd2,win2,el2=launch(other)
 eventually(lambda:bookmark_button(win2,"가져온 북마크") is not None,"restart did not reload bookmark")
 invoke(bookmark_button(win2,"가져온 북마크"))
 eventually(lambda:str(imported).lower() in el2("AddressBox").get_value().lower(),"restart bookmark navigation",15)
 print("BOOKMARK_INVOKE_RESTART_PERSISTENCE_PASS",True,flush=True)
 close(p2,hwnd2);p2=hwnd2=None
 print("BOOKMARK_UIA_INVOKE_ACCEPTANCE_PASS",True,flush=True)
finally:
 for proc,handle in ((p,hwnd),(p2,hwnd2)):
  if proc is not None and proc.poll() is None:
   if handle:u.PostMessageW(handle,0x0010,0,0)
   try:proc.wait(timeout=5)
   except:proc.kill()
 shutil.rmtree(base,ignore_errors=True)
'@
Set-Content -LiteralPath logs\bookmark-invoke-acceptance.py -Value $accept -Encoding utf8
python -X utf8 logs\bookmark-invoke-acceptance.py
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "bookmark invoke acceptance failed" }
